scope: Retained pre-curve guide profiles for the existing death estimator self-supplied routes. Helper uses woodcutting-rates.v1.json.

assumptions: Uses the sourced F2P guide context profile with the best hatchet for each level; actual accessible gear, tree density, depletion and interaction change throughput.
Adds an explicitly assumed 2 seconds per log for handling/banking; no inventory stock is assumed.
The low-level guide rate is held constant for higher levels without a verified rate curve.
